description: Misbehaving tool: in the shared MCP server with the egress policy (classes as in E6), every call of a restricted execution runs a tool whose child process emits a marker claiming a permissive execution's identity before connecting. Without trust, the claim is accepted; with trust (trust_map: markers accepted only from the MCP server process), the child's marker is ignored and the child keeps the identity it inherited at fork. Automatic binding; same reference (exclusive destination port).
